items.title: 33.2 Sources of Water Pollution (pani ki pollution ke sources) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.2 (PDF 249-250); the point and non-point drawings are our own (Figure 33.1 is a photograph).

blocks.text: Pollution ka source (zariya) chhota aur sirf ek jagah (single point) par ho sakta hai, ya bohat si jagahein ho sakti hain jo ek jaisi ya mukhtalif pollution daalti hain. Isi base (bunyaad) par pani ki pollution ke sources do qismon mein baante jate hain.
1. Point Source Pollution (ek jagah se aane wali)

Point-source pollution woh contamination (gandagi) hai jo water body (pani) mein ek hi, discrete (alag) aur identifiable (pehchani ja sakne wali) jagah se aati hai. Kyun ke sara ganda pani ek hi jagah gir raha hota hai, is liye wahan se pollution plume (pollution ki lambi dhaar) banti hai. Girne ki jagah par ya us ke foran aage (downstream) pollutant (jaise heavy metals ya organic waste) ki concentration sab se zyada hoti hai, aur wahan localized acute toxicity (usi jagah foran hone wala shadeed zehreela asar) hota hai. Misal: ek factory apne khaas pipe se lead ya mercury salts seedha darya mein daal rahi ho. Doosri misal: chemical plant ka storage tank leak ho kar pehle mitti mein aur phir zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) mein ja raha ho.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf karkhana (factory); us ka pipe aik hi jagah darya mein khulta hai, aur wahan se narangi pollution ka plume darya ke bahao ke saath lamba ho kar phailta hai.
blocks.caption: Point source: aik pipe, aik jagah (hamari drawing; kitab ki Figure 33.1 photo hai).
blocks.long_description: Pollution aik identifiable (pehchani ja sakne wali) jagah se aati hai, is liye pipe ke foran neeche concentration sab se zyada hota hai.

blocks.title: Figure 33.1
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 33.1 ek photo hai: pipe se shehar ka sewage (urban sewage) pani ki naali mein gir raha hai. Yeh point source ki misal hai, kyun ke pollution ek hi pipe se aa rahi hai.

Non-point source pollution ko diffused pollution (phaili hui pollution) bhi kehte hain. Yeh tab hoti hai jab rainfall (barish) ya snowmelt (pighalti barf) ka pani zameen ke oopar aur andar se guzarta hai. Chalte hue yeh pani natural (qudrati) aur human-made (insan ke banaye hue) pollutants utha leta hai aur aakhir mein jheelon, daryaon, wetlands (daldali ilaqon) aur coastal waters (sahil ke qareeb ke pani) mein daal deta hai. Point source ke bar-aks NPS pollution weather events (mausam ke waqiat), jaise tez toofan, par bohat depend karti hai. Is mein bohat se pollutants ka mixture hota hai jo kam concentration mein lekin bohat bare ilaqe par phaila hota hai. Non-point sources ki kuch misalein:

items: Barish hazaron hectare kheton se faltu ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃), fertilizers (khaad) aur pesticides baha kar darya tak le jati hai.

Stormwater (toofani barish ka pani) impermeable surfaces (pakki satahein jin mein pani andar nahi jata), jaise sarkein aur car parks, par behta hai aur gariyon ka gira hua engine oil (hydrocarbons), tyres ka zinc aur sarkon ka namak saath le jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar barish ka badal; neeche teen khet (farms) aur aik sarak (road). Har jagah se narangi teer behta pani neeche darya ki poori lambai mein le jate hain.
blocks.caption: Non-point source: barish bare ilaqe se pollution baha laati hai (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Pollution kisi aik pipe se nahi balke kheton aur sarkon ke poore ilaqe se barish ke pani ke saath aati hai, is liye yeh patli lekin phaili hui hoti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Barish ka pani khet aur sarak dono se behta hai. Khet se khaad (NH₄NO₃) aur pesticides, aur sarak se engine oil, tyres ka zinc aur namak saath le kar yeh pani darya ki poori lambai mein girta hai. Koi aik pipe nahi, is liye ise non-point (phaila hua) source kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Point ya non-point source batayein aur wajah dein: (i) wastewater treatment plants ke outfall pipes jo treated (saaf kiya hua) sewage bay (khaleej) ya darya mein chhorte hain; (ii) door ki traffic ya power stations ki nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) se bani “acid rain”, jo barish ke pani mein ghuli hoti hai.
blocks.explanation: (i) Point source: pani ek pehchane ja sakne wale pipe se aata hai. (ii) Non-point source: NOₓ bohat se door ke sources se aati hai aur barish ke saath bare ilaqe par girti hai; yeh mausam par depend karti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Point aur non-point sources mein do bare farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Point source ek pehchani ja sakne wali jagah se aata hai aur us ke qareeb concentration bohat zyada hoti hai. Non-point source bare ilaqe se aata hai, kam concentration mein door tak phailta hai, aur barish ya toofan jaise mausam par depend karta hai.

rows: Ek hi pehchani ja sakne wali jagah se (pipe, leak karta tank)
Bare ilaqe ki bohat si jagahon se (khet, sarkein)
Discharge ki jagah par concentration bohat zyada (plume, acute toxicity)
Bohat se pollutants kam concentration mein door tak phaile hue
Barish, barf pighalne aur toofan jaise mausam par bohat depend

items: Point source: ek pehchani ja sakne wali jagah (pipe, leak karta tank); qareeb zyada concentration (plume).
Non-point source: barish ka behta pani bare ilaqe se pollution laata hai (khet, sarkein); kam concentration, mausam par depend.
